# Module 1 Degradation Response

*Generated by `runDegradationStudy` on 2026-09-11. 378 image/defect/severity combinations.*

Validates that the quality gate responds correctly to each failure mode, across all three FOV bands. Severity is FOV-scaled, so the same value removes the same physical retinal detail on any camera.

> These severities are **not** a clinical calibration. Synthetic defocus is not cataract and a brightness ramp is not a misaligned flash. This establishes monotonic response and detection floors, not where a human draws the ungradable line.

## Response per failure mode

| Defect | Metric | Spearman rho | Detection floor | Typical reject reason | Monotonic |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| blur | `sharpness` | -0.827 | 0.250 | `out_of_focus` | yes |
| illumination | `illumCV` | +0.553 | never | `out_of_focus` | yes |
| glare | `glare` | +0.995 | 0.375 | `glare` | yes |
| darken | `meanInt` | -0.898 | 0.625 | `out_of_focus` | yes |
| brighten | `meanInt` | +0.944 | 0.625 | `out_of_focus` | yes |
| noise | `noise` | +0.974 | 0.875 | `excessive_noise` | yes |
| haze | `contrast` | -0.740 | 0.625 | `out_of_focus` | yes |

## Leakage check

No blurred image at severity >= 0.5 reached `pass`. The frozen focus verdict in `processImage` is holding - enhancement cannot restore detail that was never captured, and it is not being allowed to pretend otherwise.
